Commentary.Commentary: So, that's it from this game. On 8th February 2020, Pakistan take on New Zealand for the 3rd place playoff. That game begins at 1000 local (0800 GMT). Till then cheers and take care!

West Indies skipper, Kimani Melius says that he is not happy the way they ended the tournament. He adds that they planned to keep it simple and stick to the plan set by the coach. Further says that realizing the game situation and how the players are performing is his biggest take from the tournament. He is happy with his performance but wants a lot more in future. Praises Ashmead Nedd for bowling brilliantly in the entire World Cup. He also praises other bowlers who put in great efforts in the nets.

Australia skipper, Mackenzie Harvey says that they can't control the weather. He also adds that the quarter-final against India was hard to lose. Further says that they struggled to build partnerships throughout the tournament as they did it today. He praises Connolly on the way he played. He ends by saying that they look to play more games and keep on performing at the highest level. Signs off by saying that they should have played better than what they displayed in the entire tournament.

Chasing a daunting target, the West Indian openers started briskly but then slowed down with the rain approaching, to counter the unforgiving DLS method. In the 13th over, Kimani Melius lost his wicket and the clouds lost control. It started raining like cats and dogs, and the match was forced to be called off. Stay tuned for the presentations...

Let's quickly recap what happened in this match! Australia were put to bat and they put on a show. Every batsman was determined to give his best and eventually, the Aussie boys posted a total in excess of 300. West Indies were known for their bowling in this tournament but it flopped today. They failed to exert much pressure and apart from the efforts of Jayden Seales and Matthew Patrick, there wasn't much flavour.

MATCH ABANDONED! A sad end to this encounter! The rain refused to relent and soon there were plenty of puddles on the ground which made it impossible for the run chase to resume. With that, West Indies come fifth and Australia sixth as the former finished higher in the group stage.

Update 1603 local (1403 GMT) - Nothing new to update as thunder and lightning along with rain continue to engulf Benoni. There are puddles on the ground and it's raining quite heavily. The chances look bleak. Stay tuned for further updates.

Update 1510 local (1310 GMT) - Bad news from all ends for West Indies! They have lost a wicket just before the rain has arrived which has forced the umpires to stop play. The covers have come on and the showers are getting heavier it seems. Let's hope that the rain goes away as soon as possible and the play can resume.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kimani Melius' entertaining knock comes to an end. He was batting aggressively in the last couple of overs. He once again goes to search for the fence but finds the fielder this time. Scott bowls short and wide outside off, Melius makes some room on the off side and cuts it uppishly. He fails to get the distance on it as Sam Fanning manning the deep cover-point region goes slightly towards his left and grabs it. A crucial wicket this one as Melius is one of the best batters that West Indies have.
SIX! What a shot by Melius! Full ball outside off, Melius walks across towards the off side and just flicks it nonchalantly over mid-wicket as the ball goes over the fence there for a biggie.
Length ball outside off, tapped towards point.
Floated delivery on off, Melius drives it through covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Melius drives it towards mid off.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery outside off, Melius looks to defend but misses it as he plays inside the line of the delivery.
Full delivery on middle, Julien drives it through mid on for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Murphy bowls it down the leg side, Julien looks to flick but misses it. It goes past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
Tossed up delivery on off, Julien defends it out.
Flighted delivery on off, Julien defends it off the back foot.
Todd Murphy is on.

FOUR! Third one of the over! Melius is accelerating the scoring rate here. Length ball on off, Melius just stands and lofts it handsomely over the mid on fielder. The ball goes to the long on fence for a boundary. An expensive one as 13 runs come from the over.
FOUR! Exquisitely played! Sully goes short and Melius pulls it through square leg and fetches a boundary.
On a length on off, Melius plays it to point.
FOUR! Brilliant execution! Melius times this one beautifully down the ground as he lofts it over the mid on region and the ball goes over the ropes on the bounce.
Good length delivery on off, Melius blocks it well.
On a length on middle, Melius flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Powerplay 2 begins! Maximum of 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

Full delivery on middle, Melius flicks it towards fine leg for a single. End of the Powerplay. West Indies are 35/0 after 10 overs. It seems like they are not taking risks here because if the D/L method comes into play, wickets in hand will play a crucial part for them.
On a good length on middle, Melius defends it out.

It can be seen on the television that the groundsmen are getting ready to bring on the covers as they are expecting rain to be heading their way. They are standing near the fence with dark clouds approaching towards them.
Outside off, Melius lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off, Melius offers no shot to this one.
On a length on off, Melius punches it to covers.
Full delivery on middle, Julien pushes it towards mid on for a single.
On a length on middle, Julien flicks it towards fine leg for a single. End of a tight over. Only 3 runs came off it.
Good length delivery outside off, Julien shoulders arms to this one.
Outside off, Julien offers no shot to this one.
Short delivery on middle, Melius pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
On a good length on off, Melius keeps it out.

Full delivery on middle, Julien looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. The bowler appeals for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batters steal a leg bye.
Length delivery on middle, Julien plays it towards mid on for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Julien keeps it out.
On a good length on middle, Julien looks to flick but gets a leading edge on this one. The ball lobs towards point but lands safely.

FOUR! That's pulled with disdain! Willans goes short and on middle and leg, Julien just stays on the back foot and pulls it powerfully through square leg. The ball has enough on it to cross the fence.
Length delivery on off, Julien plays it to point.
On a good length on middle, Melius comes down the track and lofts it over mid on. It lands safely towards long on. The batsmen get two runs.
Full delivery on middle, Julien flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
On a good length on off, Julien defends it off the back foot.
Bowls a bouncer, Julien lets it sail through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Julien shoulders arms to this one.
On a length on off, Julien punches it to point.
WIDE! Sully bowls it wide outside off, Julien lets it go.
On a good length on off, Julien defends it off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Julien this time guides it with an angled bat towards third man and takes the run.

EDGED AND JUST SHORT! Length ball outside off, Julien looks to defend it to the off side with an angled bat. The ball takes the outside edge and falls just short of the first slip fielder. A scare for Julien!
Length ball outside off, Julien defends it off the front foot towards covers.
Full and on the pads, Melius flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Another ball outside off, Kimani leaves the ball outside his off stump.
Length ball outside off, Melius lets it be.
Full ball around off, Julien drives it towards covers where the fielder does well to stop it.
Good length ball outside off, Julien lets it be.
Short and wide of off stump, Julien cuts it through point for a couple.
Julien punches the length ball on off towards covers.
Fuller in length and on off, driven to mid off.
Length ball on off, Julien looks to defend it off the back foot but gets an inside edge towards the leg side.
Length ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Melius looks to lay bat on ball but misses it.
FOUR! Up and over the leaping mid off fielder. Melius lofts this length ball straight down the ground and beats the leaping mid off fielder for a boundary at long off.
Close leave! Melius takes the risk of leaving the ball which is very close to his off pole. He trusts that it won't come in. The ball goes past the off pole and to the keeper.
Length ball on off, Melius pushes the ball off the front foot onto the ground.
Good length ball and outside off, Melius lets it be.
Short ball on middle, Julien drops his wrists and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Julien lets it be.
Short ball and on middle, Julien ducks under it.
Full and angled into the leg pole, Julien looks to flick it but the ball brushes the thigh pad on its way to the keeper.
Fuller in length and around off, Julien defends it off the back foot towards covers.
Length ball on off, Melius punches the ball through covers for a single.
WIDE! Good take by the keeper. Sully bangs one in but down the leg side. Melius lets it go and Rowe leaps to his left to take it with one hand.
Good length ball on middle and off, Melius lofts this one over the bowler's head. The ball rolls towards long off and the batters take three. 9 runs off the over and a good one for the Windies.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
EDGED AND FOUR! Length ball just around off, Melius looks to play at this one but the ball goes off the inside edge towards the fine leg fence.
Willans bowls another one outside off, left alone.
Good length ball outside off again, Melius looks to go over covers. He mistimes it and just about clears the man inside the circle and the batters take two.
Good length ball outside off to start by Matthew Willans. Melius leaves it alone.
Matthew Willans to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Length ball around middle and off, Julien defends this one off the back foot. Good start by Australia with the ball.
Wide! This one is way outside off, Julien shoulders arms and a wide is signalled.
Length ball around the leg pole, Julien looks to flick but misses and the ball goes to the keeper. The batter expects a wide to be signalled but nothing from the umpire.
Full ball wide outside off, Julien now runs out of patience and goes for an expansive cover drive but fails to connect with the ball at all.
Another one outside off, Julien again leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, Julien leaves this one alone.
West Indies are underway! Sully starts with a very full ball on middle and leg, flicked towards the mid-wicket region and the batters take a single.

We are back for the chase. The two West Indies openers, Kimani Melius and Leonardo Julien will begin the chase. The Australian players are pumped up after a strong show with the bat as they are in a huddle and now take their positions on the field. Connor Sully to start off the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
